changes.before: function mergeWithExistingHoldings(incoming=[],existing=[]){const merged=existing.map(h=>({...h})),identityFields=new Set(["instrumentId","name","market","ticker"]);for(const next of mergeHoldings(incoming)){const index=holdingMatchIndex(merged,next);if(index<0){merged.push(next);continue}const old=merged[index],updated={...old};for(const k of holdingFields)if(next[k]!==null&&next[k]!==undefined&&next[k]!==""&&(!identityFields.has(k)||old[k]===null||old[k]===undefined||old[k]===""))updated[k]=next[k];merged[index]=updated}return merged}
